title: Lifetime Tracer
description:
A class that logs every special member call, used to run experiments.
```
[#1] default ctor
[#2] copy ctor from #1
[#3] move ctor from #2
[#3] destructor
...
```
requirements: `class Tracer` with unique id (static counter), logs in all 6 special members

Experiments (write predictions first, then compare): pass by value / `const&` / `&&`; return by value; `push_back` vs `emplace_back`; vector growth with and without `reserve`; `std::swap`; `std::sort` on 5 tracers
Summary table of counts per experiment
